name: SIMON_THE_ZEALOT
canonical: Simon the Zealot, the former zealous freedom-fighter, a hard wiry intense man of about forty with deeply sun-blackened leathery olive skin and a fierce lean hawk-featured face, intense dark human eyes (normal eyes, NOT glowing, NOT red) under heavy black brows and a tightly clenched jaw, close-cropped black hair and a sharp forked black beard, a faded scar across one cheekbone, dressed in a dark olive-and-charcoal tunic with a worn leather baldric crossing his chest, a coiled intensity in his taut bearing
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
